description: Structural record of one Python source file: its scopes, the control-flow blocks inside them, and the relations between scopes.

file_id.description: Identifier of the source file, normally its stem.

scopes.description: Every namespace in the file: the module itself, then each class, function, method and lambda.

scope_id.description: Dotted path from the module, e.g. module.Ledger42.tally

parent_id.description: scope_id of the enclosing scope; empty for the module

is_recursive.description: The scope calls its own name

max_block_depth.description: Deepest chain of control-flow blocks inside this scope, counting from 1

block_kinds.description: Distinct control-flow constructs used in this scope

blocks.description: Control-flow blocks, each pointing at its scope and its enclosing block. Optional for a model extraction; always present in a gold record.

parent_block_id.description: Enclosing block; empty when the block sits directly in the scope body

depth.description: Nesting level within the scope, starting at 1

test.description: Short rendering of the loop target or condition

relations.description: Edges between scopes: who calls whom, which scopes recurse, which class a scope inherits from.

entrypoints.description: scope_ids reached from module level or from the __main__ guard.
